title: AlphaBet: Reinforcement Learning for LLM Event Forecasting Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.22684v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Forecasting an unresolved event requires finding relevant evidence and deciding how strongly it supports each outcome. Yet outcome-based training of Large Language Model (LLM) forecasters often begins with preassembled evidence at a single prediction date, leaving evidence acquisition outside the learning loop. We introduce AlphaBet, an agentic reinforcement learning (RL) framework that trains a single LLM policy to search, reason, and report probabilities across multiple pre-resolution dates. Each dated forecast is scored by a proper scoring rule against the eventual outcome, allowing one resolved event to supervise decisions under different information states. We decompose forecasting regret into an evidence-acquisition gap and a probability-reporting gap, and show that Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)'s standard-deviation normalization can distort the reporting target under multi-class proper scores. translated_title: AlphaBet：用于大语言模型事件预测智能体的强化学习
translated_abstract: 预测一个尚未解决的事件需要找到相关证据，并判断这些证据在多大程度上支持每种可能的结果。然而，基于结果训练大语言模型（LLM）预测器的现有方法通常从单一预测日期开始使用预先收集好的证据，使得证据获取过程游离于学习循环之外。我们提出了AlphaBet，这是一个智能体强化学习（RL）框架，它训练单个LLM策略在事件解决前的多个日期进行搜索、推理并报告概率。每个带日期的预测都通过适当的评分规则与最终结果对比进行评分，从而使一个已解决的事件能够监督不同信息状态下的决策。我们将预测遗憾分解为证据获取差距和概率报告差距，并证明组相对策略优化（GRPO）的标准差归一化在多分类适当评分规则下可能会扭曲概率报告目标。在GLM-4.5-Air上，AlphaBe……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: AlphaBet是一个智能体强化学习框架，通过训练单个LLM策略在事件解决前的多个时间点自主搜索证据并报告概率，利用适当评分规则以已解决事件实现端到端监督，弥补了现有预测训练方法将证据获取排除在学习循环之外的不足。
en_tdlr: AlphaBet is an agentic reinforcement learning framework that trains a single LLM policy to search, reason, and report probabilities across multiple pre-resolution dates, using proper scoring rules for end-to-end supervision from resolved events, thereby bringing evidence acquisition inside the learning loop.
